from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from collections import Counter
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text()
class Audit(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__();self.ids=[];self.remote_images=[];self.h1=0
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='img' and a.get('src','').startswith(('http','//')):self.remote_images.append(a['src'])
  if tag=='h1':self.h1+=1
parser=Audit();parser.feed(s)
assert parser.h1==1
assert not parser.remote_images
assert not [x for x,c in Counter(parser.ids).items() if c>1]
assert len(list(Path('.').glob('*.html')))==1
assert 'October 2026' in s and 'September 2026' in s
print(f'PASS: one HTML deliverable; {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; one page title; unique IDs; no remote images.')
PY
